description:

commits_data.message:
Fix typos.

   'atrribute' -> 'attribute'
   'chararcter' -> 'character'
   'contnets' -> 'contents'
   'descrypt'/'descript' -> 'decrypt'
   'leanient' -> 'lenient'
   'mandaory' -> 'mandatory'
   'netowrk' -> 'network'

None are user-visible.


(cherry picked from commit 1b9dcff89bee553dab7c63f0fa7d34d79dd4104d)

Co-authored-by: Darius Davis <darius-wireshark@free-range.com.au>
